name: Phraetiss
description: Phraetiss was a planet in the Farrfin sector of the Galactic Core with thick and very tall grasslands.
lead_paragraphs: Phraetiss was a planet in the Farrfin sector of the Galactic Core with thick and very tall grasslands.
Lando Calrissian ran a botched operation on Phraetiss about ten years before the rise of Grand Admiral Thrawn. It was there that he made the acquaintance of the smuggler Niles Ferrier.
